{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.76

|gr1= Positions

|descr= Find the nearest road segment to certain position, within given radius.

|s1= [centre, radius, blacklist] call [[BIS_fnc_nearestRoad]]

|p1= centre: [[Position]]

|p2= radius: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 50) search radius from ''centre''

|p3= blacklist: [[Array]] - (Optional, default <sqf inline>[]</sqf>) blacklisted road objects

|r1= [[Object]] - nearest road object, [[objNull]] if not found

|x1= <sqf>private _nearestRoad = [getPosATL player, 500] call BIS_fnc_nearestRoad;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>private _nearestRoad = [getPosATL vehicle player, 50, getPosATL vehicle player nearRoads 20] call BIS_fnc_nearestRoad;</sqf>

|seealso= [[nearRoads]] [[isOnRoad]] [[roadAt]] [[roadsConnectedTo]]
}}
